pages.text: $(bold)Punch a tree.$() FallingTree is installed: break the bottom log with an axe and the whole tree comes down.$(br2)Make a crafting table, wooden tools, then stone tools. Mouse Tweaks lets you drag and scroll stacks. Middle-click in any inventory to sort it.
$(bold)Carry On$(): hold $(bold)Left Shift$() and right-click a chest or small animal with an empty hand to pick it up and carry it. Moving a full chest to a new base is one trip.
A $(bold)sleeping bag$() skips the night without moving your spawn point, so you can sleep anywhere while exploring. A $(bold)hammock$() skips the day the same way. Any wool colour works.

Craft the first $(bold)Inmis backpack$(). $(bold)H$() opens it while it is in your inventory. Each tier (Frayed, Plated, Gilded, Bejeweled, Blazing, Withered, Endless) is made from the one before, so keep upgrading it. See $(bold)@inmis$() in JEI.
